Frost Claw will not need a turn to charge if used under Hail. It will only deal half of its normal damage if used during Harsh Sunlight, Rain or Sandstorm.
cobblemon.move.galerush.desc: Has a 30% Chance of Flinching the target.
cobblemon.move.geosphere.desc: Geo-Sphere inflicts damage. It ignores the target's immunity to Ground-type moves (such as Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with Levitate or affected by Telekinesis or Magnet Rise, etc.).
cobblemon.move.geodecannon.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of geodes.
cobblemon.move.ghastlywail.desc: The user lets out a terrifying shriek, damaging every Pokemon around it.
cobblemon.move.glaciercrash.desc: The user sets off a glacier that crashes into every Pokemon around it.
cobblemon.move.jewelflash.desc: The user attacks by shooting flashes of jewels at opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.
cobblemon.move.leafdarts.desc:
Each of Leaf Darts hit has a separate accuracy check. If any hit fails, the move ends.
Since each hit has 90% base accuracy, there is a 72.9% chance that it will hit 3 times (for cumulative 60 base power), an 8.1% chance that it will hit twice (for cumulative 30 base power), a 9% chance that it will hit once (for 10 base power), and a 10% chance that it will miss outright. With all three accuracy checks and base powers taken into account, the move's effective power is 47.07.
If the target has an Ability that activates upon contact, each strike counts individually, enabling the Ability to activate multiple times.
Leaf Darts may now continue attacking after breaking a substitute. If the user is holding a King's Rock or Razor Fang, each consecutive hit has an equal chance to cause the opponent to flinch.
cobblemon.move.lightburst.desc: The user creates a light ball above it, which explodes and releases beams at the target. It also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
cobblemon.move.megalofang.desc: The user tears apart the target with its sharp fangs. It may also make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.mesmersmoke.desc: All Pokemon around the user are attacked with smoke that makes them sleep.
cobblemon.move.midnightterrain.desc: The user covers the ground under everyone's feet with darkness for five turns. This lowers the Accuracy of non-Dark or Ghost-type Pokemon.
cobblemon.move.mindblast.desc: A strong mental blast hits the targets mind. It may also cause confusion.
cobblemon.move.mysticwave.desc: The user stirs up a mystic wave, reducing one of the target's stats.
cobblemon.move.phantomgrip.desc: Has a 100% Chance of lowering the targets Speed by one Stage.
cobblemon.move.playfight.desc: The user tussles with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
cobblemon.move.quicksand.desc: Quicksand inflicts 1/8 of the target's maximum HP as damage per turn for four to five turns upon use, in addition to the damage dealt when it is used. It also traps the target, preventing switching and escape. If a trapped Pokemon uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed.
cobblemon.move.razorblade.desc: It deals damage and has a high critical hit ratio, similarly to Leaf Blade, as they have the same base power, and same effects.
cobblemon.move.shattergem.desc: The user shatters the gem it holds to unleash a great light. The type of the move changes depending on the held Gem
cobblemon.move.shiningterrain.desc: The user covers the ground under everyone's feet with solar flares for five turns. This hurts grounded non-Fire-type Pokemon.
cobblemon.move.siphonbite.desc: An energy-draining bite. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.solarclaw.desc:
Solar Claw does nothing on the turn it is selected, other than state that the user has taken in sunlight. On the following turn, Solar Claw will inflict damage, PP will be deducted from it, and it will count as the last move used. Once Solar Claw is selected, the user will not be able to switch out until it is disrupted or fully executed.
Solar Claw will not need a turn to charge if used under Harsh Sunlight. It will only deal half of its normal damage if used during Rain, Sandstorm or Hail.
cobblemon.move.solarflare.desc: The target is enveloped in a great sphere of flame. Forces the target to keep using the same move for three turns.
cobblemon.move.squallblow.desc: The user whips up cyclones towards both opponents. This hits both opponents in Double Battles.
cobblemon.move.sulfuricspray.desc: The user sprays the target. This attack ignores Steel-type's immunity to Poison-type.
cobblemon.move.talongash.desc: Talon Gash hits twice in a row. Both hits calculate damage separately and each hit can get a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.tikitorch.desc: Inflicts damage, and has a 50% chance of burning.
cobblemon.move.trickshot.desc: The user distracts the target, then shoot them with small rocks or other pellets. This may also make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.atomicpunch.desc: Atomic Punch deals damage and has a 15% chance of paralyzing the target.
cobblemon.move.coralbreak.desc: Despite being a Special move, Coral Break uses the target's Defense to calculate damage.
cobblemon.move.drainlife.desc:
Drain Life heals the user for half the damage it deals (rounded down), unless the target has the Liquid Ooze ability, in which case the user will lose health instead.
If it is used against a substitute Drain Life will heal the user when damaging it.
Drain Life cannot be used if the user is under the effects of Heal Block.
cobblemon.move.expunge.desc:
Expunge deals damage and is super effective against Nuclear-type Pokemon. However, non-Nuclear Pokemon may call it using Nature Power in irradiated areas.
Its accuracy increases to 100% during Nuclear Fallout.
cobblemon.move.fallout.desc: Fallout summons a Nuclear Fallout onto the field for five turns, dealing damage every odd-numbered turn to all Pokemon except Nuclear- and Steel-types.
cobblemon.move.fissionburst.desc: Fission Burst deals damage and causes the user to faint.
cobblemon.move.flameimpact.desc: The user tackles the target at high temps gained by air friction. This attack always goes first.
cobblemon.move.gammaray.desc: Gamma Ray deals damage and has no secondary effects.
cobblemon.move.gemstoneglimmer.desc: Gemstone Glimmer deals damage and has a 25% chance of lowering the foeâ€™s accuracy.
cobblemon.move.getlucky.desc: Get Lucky deals damage and then raises the user's critical hit rate by two stages.
cobblemon.move.goldenfist.desc:
Golden Fist inflicts damage to the target and scatters coins that are to be picked up by the player at the end of the battle, indicated by the text "Player picked up xxxx$! The amount of money picked up is equal to five times the user's level.
This attack can be used multiple times, with each additional attack adding to the total money collected at the end of the battle.
The money yielded by this attack is affected by Amulet Coin.
cobblemon.move.halflife.desc: Half-Life deals damage equal to half the target's current HP and has no secondary effect. Half-Life will cause the target to faint if it only has 1 HP left.
cobblemon.move.infernalblade.desc: If used on a Fairy-type target that would usually resist a Fire-type move due to their typing, such as Luxelong or Syrentide, Infernal Blade will ignore their other type and still hit for super-effective damage.
cobblemon.move.instantcrush.desc: Instant Crush is a damage-dealing Psychic-type move; it inflicts damage and is an increased priority move.
cobblemon.move.laserpulse.desc: Although displayed as a Normal-type move, the effective typing of Laser Pulse is selected randomly between Fire, Ice, and Electric. Laser Pulse is therefore never affected by type-changing Abilities like Pixilate, Energizate or Atomizate, and the effects of moves like Ion Deluge.
cobblemon.move.metalcruncher.desc: Metal Cruncher deals damage to the target and has an 85% chance of lowering the target's defense by one stage.
cobblemon.move.metalwhip.desc: Metal Whip partially traps the target and deals 1/16 of the targets HP at the end of each turn. If a Binding Band is held by the user, the damage done at the end of each turn will increase from 1/16 of the target's maximum HP to 1/8. If the target uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed.
cobblemon.move.nuclearslash.desc: Nuclear Slash deals damage and has a high critical hit rate.
cobblemon.move.nuclearwaste.desc: Nuclear Waste badly poisons the target. This move bypasses Lead Skin's immunity to Nuclear-type moves
cobblemon.move.nuclearwind.desc: Nuclear Wind deals damage and has a 5% chance of summoning Nuclear Fallout onto the field.
cobblemon.move.oceanswrath.desc: Traps foes in a giant whirlpool for four to five turns.
cobblemon.move.protonbeam.desc: Proton Beam deals damage and lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.
cobblemon.move.quantumleap.desc: Quantum Leap causes the user to vanish on the turn it is used, making it semi-invulnerable. It will return to the field the next turn, dealing damage to the target.
cobblemon.move.radioacid.desc: Radioacid deals damage and has a 30% chance to burn the target.
cobblemon.move.skyfall.desc: Sky Fall deals damage and has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.
cobblemon.move.stickyterrain.desc: The user makes the ground all slimy and gooey for five turns. Priority attacks won't work.
cobblemon.move.subduction.desc: Subduction deals damage, then lowers the target's speed by 2 stages and confuses the user.
cobblemon.move.suddenstrike.desc: It deals damage and is an increased priority move.
cobblemon.move.thunderstorm.desc: Thunderstorm summons a Thunderstorm onto the field for five turns
cobblemon.move.abyssallure.desc: Sharply raise Sp. Atk on KO
cobblemon.move.audacity.desc: User faints in 3 turns. +2 Atk and Speed, +6 Evasion.
cobblemon.move.fangbarrage.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the target's current HP
cobblemon.move.geosplinter.desc: Priority +3, Switches Atk and Def stats
cobblemon.move.hivemind.desc: SpA damage on Foe's Defense stat
cobblemon.move.knightsvow.desc: Heals party of any status effects
cobblemon.move.miresurge.desc: 50% chance of lowering the target's Speed by one stage
cobblemon.move.ripen.desc: Increases the User's Defense by one stage, increases the user's Special Attack by two stages
cobblemon.move.swindle.desc: Steals money from the opposing trainer
cobblemon.move.toxifume.desc: Increases the User's Special Attack the first turn, the second turn it deals damage and poisons the target
cobblemon.move.twirlenade.desc: Increases the User's Evasion by one stage, increases the user's Speed by two stages. Confuses the User
cobblemon.move.veiledsky.desc: Summons an eclipse that blackens the field
cobblemon.move.dracobarrage.desc: This attack beats fairy immunities but hurts the user. Changes split based off which is stronger.
cobblemon.move.frostrush.desc: This move has a 10% chance for the following secondary effect: Causes the target to flinch.
cobblemon.move.freezingwater.desc: Decreases the target's Attack by 1 stage.
cobblemon.move.fairyrush.desc: This move has a 20% chance for the following secondary effect: Causes the target to flinch. Inflicts double damage and has perfect accuracy if the target is Minimized.
cobblemon.move.poltervenom.desc: This move has a 30% chance for the following secondary effect: Poisons the target.
cobblemon.move.turbodrive.desc: This move has a 30% chance for the following secondary effect: Paralyzes the target.
cobblemon.move.bulletswing.desc:
Base power depends on the calculation of (user's Speed / target's Speed), rounded down. The power is then:
(Result is 4 or greater) - 150.
(Result is 3) - 120.
(Result is 2) - 80.
(Result is 1) - 60.
(Result is less than 1) - 40.
cobblemon.move.bloodmoonlockemon.desc: This move sets weather Blood Moon
cobblemon.move.duststorm.desc: This move creates a Dust Storm
cobblemon.move.adamantwing.desc: Hits twice, then deals an extra hit at +2, +4, and +6 stat stages in Defense, for a maximum of 5 hits. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. Its number of hits is unaffected by Loaded Dice or Skill Link.
cobblemon.move.amberhammer.desc: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage. Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
cobblemon.move.apexbeam.desc: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Detect, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends. This move fails if used under Gravity.
cobblemon.move.callingcard.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's accuracy by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn. If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
cobblemon.move.claypulse.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Special Attack stat are used as normal.
cobblemon.move.crystalcure.desc: Restores 25% and any non-volatile status from the target, lowers their Speed by one stage.
cobblemon.move.dustkick.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
cobblemon.move.echolocate.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.
cobblemon.move.fixitflurry.desc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
cobblemon.move.fullmoonsault.desc: Summons Gravity for 3 turns upon use. Additional effect will not trigger if Gravity is already in effect.
cobblemon.move.heatslash.desc: This move has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit. It will thaw out the user if it is frozen, and then inflict damage on the target.
cobblemon.move.nightparade.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
cobblemon.move.puffup.desc: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.
cobblemon.move.roulette.desc:
Rolls a Roulette (00,0,1-36) with the following outcomes each having a 1/38 chance to occur to all Pokemon on the field:
00 	The user explodes
0 	Raises Attack by 1 stage
1 	Lowers Attack by 1 stage
2 	Raises Defense by 1 stage
3 	Lowers Defense by 1 stage
4 	Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage
5 	Lowers Sp. Atk by 1 stage
6 	Raises Sp. Def by 1 stage
7 	Lowers Sp. Def by 1 stage
8 	Raises Speed by 1 stage
9 	Lowers Speed by 1 stage
10 	Raises Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by 1 stage
11 	Lowers Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by 1 stage
12 	Raises critical-hit rate by 2 stages
13 	Inflicts burn
14 	Inflicts poison
15 	Inflicts paralysis
16 	Inflicts confusion
17 	Sets Stealth Rock
18 	Sets Spikes
19 	Sets Toxic Spikes
20 	Sets Sticky Web
21 	Summons Sunny Day
22 	Summons Rain Dance
23 	Summons Snowscape
24 	Summons Sandstorm
25 	Summons Grassy Terrain
26 	Summons Electric Terrain
27 	Summons Misty Terrain
28 	Summons Psychic Terrain
29 	Summons Toxic Terrain
30 	Summons Trick Room
31 	Summons Gravity
32 	Applies Defog's effect to the field
33 	Applies Court Change's effect
34 	Applies Substitute's effect to all battlers
35 	Applies Pain Split's effect to all battlers
36 	Applies Perish Song's effect to all battlers

Regular immunities apply in all cases.
cobblemon.move.runepower.desc: This move's type is changed from Rock to whatever the Pokemon's primary Type is. If the Pokemon is somehow Typeless, it reverts to Rock-type. This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. As a result of its function, it always has STAB.
cobblemon.move.scrapshot.desc: The move starts at 40 base power, adding another 40 for each layer of entry hazard on the user's side of the field, up to a max of 320 base power with three layers of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web and two layers of Toxic Spikes. The hazards are then removed after the move's execution.
cobblemon.move.sirensong.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Chilly Reception, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.
cobblemon.move.thornfall.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.toxicterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Toxic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Poison-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, and grounded Pokemon are prevented from restoring any HP. Nature Power becomes Sludge Bomb and Terrain Pulse doubles in power and becomes Poison type. Fails if the current terrain is Toxic Terrain.
cobblemon.move.trashtalk.desc: Power doubles if the target's last used move, including moves called by other moves or those used through Magic Coat, or the Magic Bounce Ability, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, or if the target was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging. A move that was blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity or Smack Down.
cobblemon.move.uproot.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect ignores Ingrain and Suction Cups but still fails if this move hit a Substitute.
cobblemon.move.voidburst.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 10% chance to confuse the target per hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit fives times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move has an even chance to hit four or five times.
cobblemon.move.wrangle.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Chilly Reception, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin, Wriggle or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
cobblemon.move.wriggle.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of binding and trapping moves end for the user. It does not clear hazards.
cobblemon.move.swoop.desc: Swoop inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.
cobblemon.move.mesmerize.desc: Mesmerize puts the target to sleep. Mesmerize cannot affect targets with Insomnia, Vital Spirit or Sap Sipper as their Ability.
cobblemon.move.transpiration.desc: When Transpiration is used, rainfall will start on the field which will last for five turns. (If the user is holding a Damp Rock this will last for eight turns.) If it is already raining Transpiration will fail. It also heals the user by 1/4 of their total HP when used.
cobblemon.move.kaolinbash.desc: A bash coated in fresh clay deals damage. Water Types are dried up and take super-effective damage.
cobblemon.move.diamondbreath.desc: Opposing Pokemon are blasted with rare ores. This may lower the target's Special Defense.
cobblemon.move.ironbarb.desc: The target is struck with a sharp object.
cobblemon.move.ironstrike.desc: The user gives a harsh strike with its tail, knocking out its target drastically increases Attack stat.
cobblemon.move.frostwalker.desc: The user cloaks itself in ice and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat. It can be used to freeze water to traverse it.
cobblemon.move.primalsun.desc: The user maximizes its Special Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
cobblemon.move.shadowstep.desc: The user swiftly strikes its target. It is sure to strike first.
cobblemon.move.fangleech.desc: A life-stealing attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.wavelash.desc: The user slashes the target with water.
cobblemon.move.firecrackers.desc: The target is attacked with small exploding flames. It may leave the target burned.
cobblemon.move.swiftstrike.desc: The user swiftly strikes its target. It is sure to strike first.
cobblemon.move.heatedrevup.desc: By heating up, the user's Atk, Spatk and Speed are sharply raised. Only works the first turn.
cobblemon.move.nightshadebouquet.desc: A bouquet filled with nightshades is thrown at the target, dealing damage and leaving a layer of toxic spikes.
cobblemon.move.whirlyhelix.desc: A mighty gale storms the opponent. It does more damage the faster the user is.
cobblemon.move.vindunar.desc: Mystical wind attack the target. Uses highest attack stat and never misses under Rain.
cobblemon.move.codeinjection.desc: By editing the enemy's data, a virus is injected. This may also lower the target's Sp.Defense.
cobblemon.move.filthyterrain.desc: The user makes the ground under everyone's feet turn filthy, boosting Poison-type moves and intensifying poison damage.
cobblemon.move.boilingshower.desc: The user showers the target with bubbling hot water. This may also leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.sharpcut.desc: The user makes sure to strike the target's weak point. This attack always results in a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.downpour.desc: The user bombards the target from above with an immeasurable amount of water. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.move.sandwave.desc: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can't flee from battle.
cobblemon.move.skydive.desc: The user dives down from the sky onto the target at incredible speed. This can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
cobblemon.move.lovelariat.desc: The target is squeezed tightly. This attack does massive damage to a target that is infatuated.
cobblemon.move.goldbreaker.desc: The user slams the target with two arms of solid gold. Money is earned after the battle.
cobblemon.move.meteorshower.desc: The user attacks everything around it with pretty lights that rain like comets. This may also induce sleep.
cobblemon.move.accelvolt.desc:
When it is used, it does a turn check based on the user's Speed and the opponent's Speed.
If the opponent is faster, the user's Speed is raised by 1 stage.
If the user is faster, Special Attack is raised by 1 stage.
If your opponent uses a priority damage dealing move, the user's Speed is raised.
If Prankster or Gale Wings is used to outspeed, the user's Speed is raised by 1 Stage.
cobblemon.move.aromawind.desc: 10% chance to inflict Confusion or Sleep on (targets multiple opponents).
cobblemon.move.lusterbloom.desc: It is a move with 80 BP, 100 acc, 10 PP, and of the Special category, and has a 10% chance to reduce the foe's accuracy.
cobblemon.move.boldblaze.desc: If the target's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power (so in other words, it is a Fire-type clone of Brine).
cobblemon.move.terrafirm.desc: It is a Curse clone (without the Ghost effect), buffing the user's Atk/Def while lowering Spe.
cobblemon.move.soilthrow.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense.
cobblemon.move.regalfang.desc: Regal Fang bypasses Flying-type Immunity, including Levitate, and deals damage. Unlike Thousand Arrows, Regal Fang does not ground the opponent to be susceptible to Ground-type moves.
cobblemon.move.warble.desc: It is a status-category move that lowers the target's Special Defense by a stage.
cobblemon.move.glorywing.desc: It is Special category, 95 BP, 100 acc and 15 PP, with a chance to raise the user's Special Attack.
cobblemon.move.hairpinturn.desc: It is a move that increases the user's Speed and Evasion by a single stage.
cobblemon.move.quickturn.desc: It has 70 BP, 100 Accuracy, 15 PP and is of the Physical category.
cobblemon.move.mysticchant.desc: is guaranteed to hit the opponent as long as they are not in a semi-invulnerable state, such as when using Fly.
cobblemon.move.exsanguinate.desc: Exsanguinate is basically Dark-type Giga Drain with the same effect of healing up to 50% of the damage dealt to the target.
cobblemon.move.cryoshock.desc: It is of the Physical category with 85 Power, 100% Accuracy and 15 PP that has a 10% chance of inflicting frozen status to the target.
cobblemon.move.blackhole.desc: Black Hole is basically a Dark type Draco Meteor/Overheat/Leaf Storm variant with the same stats and downside of dropping Special Attack by 2 Stages.
cobblemon.move.rocketdrive.desc: Rocket Drive is basically Steel-type Wild Charge with the same drawback: Deals recoil equal to 25% of the damage done to the target.
cobblemon.move.shadowsplit.desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
cobblemon.move.hardknock.desc: Hard Knock inflicts damage, but it uses the user's Defense stat instead of its Attack stat to calculate damage
cobblemon.move.speedmite.desc: It is quite literally, an Accelerock clone.
cobblemon.move.neurotoxin.desc: inflicts poison or paralysis status to the target.
cobblemon.move.windmill.desc:
It has the unique property of changing category depending on the Pokemon that has it (for example, it is Physical on Fruitius, but Special on FÅ«pyan). It is not determined by IVs, PV * or any other hidden factor. Physical: 20% chance to raise user's Speed.
Special: 20% chance to lower Target's Speed and raise user's Speed.
cobblemon.move.astroforce.desc: has a 10% chance of raising all of the user's stats by one stage.
cobblemon.move.terrahedron.desc: 40% chance of raising the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
cobblemon.move.chromeball.desc: It has a 20% chance to drop the foe's Sp Def.
cobblemon.move.marveltrick.desc: Marvel Trick switches the user's raw Special Attack stat with its raw Special Defense stat. Stat modifiers are not swapped. The effect of Marvel Trick may be Baton Passed to swap the recipient's stats. Using Marvel Trick again will swap the user's stats again, but will not prevent Baton Pass from passing the effect.
cobblemon.move.engorge.desc: Engorge deals damage to a target.
cobblemon.move.electrobash.desc: Electrobash has a 20% chance to inflict paralysis.
cobblemon.move.aquaimpact.desc: Aqua Impact is basically Wave Crash with the same drawback: Deals recoil to user equal to 1/3 of the damage done to target
cobblemon.move.grimrancor.desc: Grim Rancor has a 30% chance to paralyze the opponent. Grim Rancor cannot paralyze Electric-type Pokemon
cobblemon.move.titanichorn.desc: Titanic Horn is basically Steel type Megahorn.
cobblemon.move.prismattack.desc: It has a unique mechanic where the move is not Normal, but in fact is based on the primary type of the user.
cobblemon.move.grimebuster.desc: It is a physical version of Overheat, sharply reducing the Attack stat by two stages when used.
cobblemon.move.pherotoxin.desc: 100% chance to Poison the Target and possibly Infatuate the target as well.
cobblemon.move.royalbreath.desc: Royal Breath deals damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Special Attack by one stage.
cobblemon.move.dynasword.desc: If the user's previous move was Hone Claws, Dynasword's Base Power will be twice the base power. If its next move is not Dynasword or a non-damaging move, the doubled base power wears off without being used.
cobblemon.move.iceentomb.desc: inflicts frozen status to the target

cobblemon.ability.sunbathe.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in sunlight.
cobblemon.ability.teamplayer.desc: The Pokémon and it's ally get increased boosts during double battles.
cobblemon.ability.absolution.desc: During intense darkness, Absolution increases the Pokémon's Special Attack by 50 percent, but the Pokémon loses 1/8 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.ability.ancientpresence.desc:
All damaging moves which follow the standard damage formula gain the same-type attack bonus even if the moves are not the same type as the user.
All damaging moves used by the wielder of Ancient Presence will always deal neutral damage, meaning all attacks ignore standard type-effectiveness relationships. Moves used under the effects of Ancient Presence still adhere to item or ability-based type-immunity such as Air Balloon or Levitate.
Ancient Presence overrides type effectiveness granted by the ability Omnitype. Pokémon with the ability Wonder Guard are completely immune to damaging attacks under the effects of Ancient Presence.
cobblemon.ability.athenian.desc: Athenian doubles the Special Attack stat of the Pokémon with this Ability
cobblemon.ability.blazeboost.desc: Immediately before the user uses a Fire-type attack its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are increased by 1 stage. When Blaze Boost is activated by Delta Emolga, its form changes. When in this form, there is a 10% chance that Pokémon using a contact move against Delta Emolga will become burned.
cobblemon.ability.castlemoat.desc: When a Pokémon with Castle Moat is hit by an Water-type move, its Special Defense is increased by one stage, and the move will have no effect on that Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.chlorofury.desc: When a Pokémon with Chlorofury enters the battle, its Speed is raised by one stage and its Special Attack is raised by one stage for each fainted Pokémon on the user's team. After two turns, these stat changes are removed.
cobblemon.ability.etherealshroud.desc:
Ethereal Shroud causes the user to gain Ghost-type-associated immunities and resistances, effectively giving them three defensive types in the event that the user already possesses a primary type and a secondary type. Ethereal Shroud does not give Ghost-type moves a damage increase via same-type attack bonus, and it also does not give the user weaknesses associated with its new Ghost typing.
Pokémon with the Abilities Scrappy, Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze are able to bypass Ethereal Shroud using Fighting-type and Normal-type moves. Using Foresight or Odor Sleuth also allows Fighting-type and Normal-type moves to bypass Ethereal Shroud. Trick-or-Treat and Forest's Curse will both fail when used against Pokémon with Ethereal Shroud. Soak, Dragonify, and Medusa Ray will not fail, however they also will not negate the Ghost-type-associated immunities and resistances gained from Ethereal Shroud.
cobblemon.ability.eventhorizon.desc: Any Pokémon that makes contact with this one can't escape.
cobblemon.ability.foundry.desc:
Foundry causes all Rock-type moves used by the Pokémon with this Ability to become Fire-type and receive a 30% damage boost, in addition to all other modifiers.
Furthermore, Foundry also causes Stealth Rock to become a Fire-type entry hazard that stacks with the normal, Rock-type Stealth Rock.
cobblemon.ability.glitch.desc: Glitch has a 100% chance to instantly faint opposing Pokémon when hit by a contact move.
cobblemon.ability.heliophobia.desc: During harsh sunlight, a Pokémon with Heliophobia will lose ⅛ of its maximum HP at the end of each turn. During intense darkness, a Pokémon with Heliophobia will regain ⅛ of its maximum HP at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.ability.hubris.desc: When a Pokémon with Hubris causes another Pokémon (including allies) to faint through direct damage, its Special Attack rises by one stage. Hubris will not be activated by indirect damage, such as through Sandstorm or an item like Rocky Helmet. Hubris will not activate if an allied Pokémon defeats a foe in a Double or Triple Battle.
cobblemon.ability.icecleats.desc: During hail, the Speed stat of Pokémon with this Ability is doubled. A Pokémon with this Ability will take no damage from hail if it otherwise would.
cobblemon.ability.intoxicate.desc: Intoxicate causes all Normal-type moves used by the Pokémon to become Poison-type and receive a 30% power boost.
cobblemon.ability.lernean.desc: Pokémon with Lernean will gain more heads if their HP decreases below 80%, 60%, 40%, or 20%, gaining multiple heads if their HP falls below multiple of these thresholds at once. Restoring HP does not remove heads and more heads will not generate if a threshold has previously been reached. Lernean then splits the power of the user's damaging moves across each head.
cobblemon.ability.noctem.desc: Noctem summons darkness in battle as soon as a Pokémon with Noctem enters the battle. Its effects are the same as the move New Moon.
cobblemon.ability.omnitype.desc: All moves used against the target will factor in the weaknesses and resistances of every type at once, and grants the user type-based immunity effects.
cobblemon.ability.pendulum.desc: Boosts the power of moves used repeatedly. Each time a move is used consecutively, its power is boosted by 20% up to a maximum increase of 100%. Switching or using another move returns the move's power to normal. Multi-strike moves are counted by the number of turns on which they are used, not the number of hits made. It also stacks with Metronome, which offers an identical power boost for every consecutive usage.
cobblemon.ability.periodicorbit.desc: When the moves Doom Desire, Future Sight, or Wish are used, they will activate twice after a single use. Wish will activate one and three turns after the move is originally used. Doom Desire and Future Sight will activate two and five turns after the move is originally used, and each will block further uses of Doom Desire or Future Sight until the second activation lands.
cobblemon.ability.phototroph.desc: Pokémon with Phototroph restore 1/16 of their total HP at the end of each turn. The effects of Phototroph are doubled during harsh sunlight and are completely negated when the sky is dark or heavy rain is in effect.
cobblemon.ability.prismguard.desc: When a Pokémon with Prism Guard is hit with an attack that does not make contact, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of its own HP, after all turn-based damage is dealt. If Prism Guard causes both the user and the attacker to faint, then the attacker will faint first. It is the non-contact counterpart to Iron Barbs and Rough Skin.
cobblemon.ability.proteanmaxima.desc:
At the start of the turn, if directed to use a move of a type that corresponds to an Eeveelution, Mega Eevee will transform into the form corresponding to that Eeveelution, giving it the type, base stats (including HP) and ability of that Eeveelution. Using a Normal-type move changes Eevee back to its base Mega Evolution form. Protean Maxima is not replaced by the new ability; using a move of a different applicable type will cause Eevee to transform again.
When Mega Eevee transforms into a formAspects with a different base HP, its current HP will be revised to its new maximum HP minus the amount of HP it had lost before changing formAspects (unless that would put Eevee's HP at 0 or lower, in which case Eevee's HP is reduced to 1 instead). This also occurs when Mega Eevee transforms back into its non-Mega formAspects after a battle ends.
cobblemon.ability.psychocall.desc: Boosts Psychic-Type moves in a pinch.
cobblemon.ability.regurgitation.desc: When a Pokémon with the Ability Regurgitation successfully using an attack or targetable status move, it will deal additional damage against the target. This damage is equal to 1/6 of the target's maximum HP multiplied by the effectiveness of the Regurgitation type against the target, which is determined by the primary typing of the Pokémon within Delta Muk's mouth. The type can be Water, Grass, Fire, Dark, Normal, or Psychic corresponding to Horsea, Bellsprout, Magby, Deino, Whismur, and Natu, respectively.
cobblemon.ability.shadowcall.desc: Boosts Dark-Type moves in a pinch.
cobblemon.ability.shadowdance.desc: During intense darkness, the Speed stat of Pokémon with this Ability is doubled.
cobblemon.ability.shadowsynergy.desc: Shadow Synergy boosts the power of the user's Dark-type moves by 50%.
cobblemon.ability.sleet.desc: Sleet summons and increases the damage of hail. Pokémon that are not immune to hail damage are damaged for 20% of their maximum HP at the end of each turn while Sleet is active. Sleet's effects are removed when Pokémon with Sleet are no longer on the field or hail stops. If hail stops but becomes active again while a Pokémon with Sleet is on the field, Sleet will immediately begin modifying the damage of hail.
cobblemon.ability.spectraljaws.desc: Spectral Jaws causes all biting moves used by the Pokémon to be reclassified as Special moves and receive a 30% boost.
cobblemon.ability.speedswap.desc: Speed Swap starts Trick Room in battle as soon as a Pokémon with Speed Swap enters the battle. If a Pokémon with Speed Swap enters the battle while Trick Room is already in effect, Trick Room will end immediately.
cobblemon.ability.spiritcall.desc: Boosts Ghost-Type moves in a pinch.
cobblemon.ability.supercell.desc:
During intense darkness or rain, Supercell increases the Special Attack stat of the Pokémon with this Ability by 1.5×.
Supercell changes Delta Typhlosion from its Inactive Mode to Active Mode during darkness or rain.
cobblemon.ability.syntheticalloy.desc: Pokémon with Synthetic Alloy take neutral damage from Fire-type attacks regardless of their type-specific weaknesses.
cobblemon.ability.unleafed.desc: When a Pokémon with Unleafed enters the battle, its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are increased by one stage each. These boosts last X + 1 turns, where X is the number of fainted Pokémon on this Pokémon´s team at the time of the ability's activation. After X + 1 turns, the stat changes are removed.
cobblemon.ability.vampiric.desc: Vampiric allows the user to regain 25% of the damage inflicted when using a contact move. The amount of HP recovered is unaffected by Big Root. If the effects of Heal Block are active, then Vampiric cannot restore HP.
cobblemon.ability.vaporization.desc: Causes damage-dealing Water-type moves and targetable Water-type status moves to fail when used. Damages all Water-type Pokémon for ⅛ of their maximum HP at the end of every turn.
cobblemon.ability.venomous.desc: A Pokémon with Venomous always causes bad poison instead of regular poison.
cobblemon.ability.windforce.desc: When a Pokémon with Wind Force is hit by a Flying-type move, its Speed is increased by one stage, and the move will have no effect on that Pokémon. Wind Force will not activate if the Pokémon is protected from the Flying-type move.
cobblemon.ability.winterjoy.desc: During the months of November, December, January, and February, the Attack and Special Attack of Pokémon with this Ability are increased by 40%. During the months of May, June, July, and August the Attack and Special Attack of Pokémon with this ability are decreased by 30%. During the remaining four months, stats are unchanged.
cobblemon.ability.purefocus.desc: Raises the Pokémon's Special Attack stat.
cobblemon.ability.creamshield.desc: Lowers the damage taken from opposing Pokémon the healthier the user is.
cobblemon.ability.cloudburst.desc: Cloud Burst changes the ability-bearer's formAspects to 'Cloud Burst' when their health falls at or below 50%.
cobblemon.ability.dreadspace.desc: Makes the move of the foe, regardless if it's status/physical/special, use 2 PP instead of 1.
cobblemon.ability.junglespirit.desc: Boosts the power of moves that are the same type as Shyleon. It is required to have it's hidden ability to use Shyleon's Astral formAspects.
cobblemon.ability.majesticaura.desc: If an opponent uses a priority move that targets the Pokémon with Majestic Aura or its allies, Majestic Aura prevents the Pokémon from executing that move (PP is still consumed).
cobblemon.ability.voicetuning.desc: Boosts the power of moves that are the same type as Trishout. It is required to have it's hidden ability to use Trishout's Astral formAspects.
cobblemon.ability.dragonarmor.desc: Boosts the power of moves that are the same type as Shulong. It is required to have it's hidden ability to use Shulong's Astral formAspects.
cobblemon.ability.piggybank.desc: When the Pokémon has participated in a battle, prize money is doubled.
cobblemon.ability.synthesizer.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a Sound-type move, its HP is restored by 1/4 of its maximum HP, and the move will have no effect on that Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.raptor.desc: Raptor gives priority when attacking a weak pokémon, which translates to gaining +1 priority when attacking a target with 25% hit points or less remaining.
cobblemon.ability.dirtypool.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle or ends a turn with its HP above 25%, it changes from Solo Form to Monster Form. The formAspects will revert if the Pokémon's HP falls below 25%.
cobblemon.ability.equalize.desc: Turns Normal-type attacks into Sound-type moves and boosts their power
cobblemon.ability.scalate.desc: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type and boosts their power.
cobblemon.ability.holyguard.desc: Holy Guard raises either the Defense stat or Special Defense stat by one stage depending on the foe's currently highest attack stat: it will raise Defense if the foe's current Attack is higher than its current Special Attack stat; otherwise, it will raise Special Defense.
cobblemon.ability.mysticwind.desc: A pokémon with this ability will as the description state gain the resistances of the Fairy-type. This would make the pokémon more resistant to Bug, Fighting and Dark.
cobblemon.ability.solarprominence.desc: It reduces the power of all attacks toward it by 33%, regardless of whether or not it's a contact move.
cobblemon.ability.aircontrol.desc: The user's STAB moves are increased by 100% instead of 50%
cobblemon.ability.amalgam.desc: User changes type to the last move it used
cobblemon.ability.ambush.desc: User's moves cannot miss during an Eclipse
cobblemon.ability.barbednest.desc: User takes half damage from contact moves and inflicts 1/8th Max HP recoil on the contacting Foe
cobblemon.ability.chargedwool.desc: User's Normal moves are now Electric type and deal 20% increased damage
cobblemon.ability.crystalcase.desc: Immune to Water and 1.5x weak to Fire. When hit by Fire move, sharply raises Special Attack (+2)
cobblemon.ability.elusive.desc: Gives an extra 50% evasion to all status moves
cobblemon.ability.empathy.desc: Lower's foe's offenses when making contact with user
cobblemon.ability.foulshroud.desc: User's evasion is increased during an Eclipse
cobblemon.ability.fruitrition.desc: Self recovery moves heal an extra 25%
cobblemon.ability.glacialize.desc: User's Normal moves are now Ice type and deal 20% increased damage
cobblemon.ability.insatiable.desc: User's draining moves deal more damage
cobblemon.ability.laserfocus.desc: Increases power of beam moves by 50%
cobblemon.ability.levinskin.desc: Sharply raises Attack (+2) when hit by an Electric move
cobblemon.ability.lithe.desc: User's speed doubles when suffering from a status condition, ignores Paralysis speed drop
cobblemon.ability.luckystar.desc: Multiplies the accuracy of all the user's moves by 1.3x
cobblemon.ability.powerfist.desc: All punching moves increase in power by 20%
cobblemon.ability.prowler.desc: Doubles the damage of any copied moves (Assist, Mirror Move, Mimic, etc.)
cobblemon.ability.regalia.desc: User's Normal moves are now Fairy type and deal 20% increased damage
cobblemon.ability.resolute.desc: At full health, user will survive an otherwise lethal blow with 1HP
cobblemon.ability.siegedrive.desc: Increases power of projectile moves by 50%
cobblemon.ability.specialist.desc: Increases power of HM moves by 50%
cobblemon.ability.tactician.desc: User's not very effective moves deal double damage to foes
cobblemon.ability.visionary.desc: User's Normal moves can now hit Ghost types
cobblemon.ability.amperate.desc: Amperate causes all Normal-type moves used by the Pokémon to become Electric-type and receive a 30% power boost.
cobblemon.ability.bloodthirst.desc: The user's biting moves will also heal 1/8th of its total HP. Healing is negated if Heal Block is in play. The user takes damage if used on a target with Liquid Ooze. This does not count as an absorbing effect, so a Big Root will not boost it.
cobblemon.ability.bouncy.desc: Inflicts damage equal to 1/3 HP lost by the user to the foe when attacked by a physical move.
cobblemon.ability.equilibrium.desc: When a Pokémon with Equilibrium enters the battle, several conditions are removed. This includes stat changes, status ailments, weather effects, terrain effects, rooms (such as Trick Room), entry hazards, Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, and Lucky Chant.
cobblemon.ability.flameeater.desc:
When a Pokémon with Flame Eater is hit by a Fire-type move, its HP is restored by one quarter of its maximum HP, and the move will have no effect on that Pokémon (if a Pokémon with this Ability already has full HP, the Fire-type move will do nothing instead).
Flame Eater will not activate if the Pokémon is protected from the Fire-type move.
cobblemon.ability.lunardiffuse.desc: When a Pokémon with Lunar Diffuse enters the battle, it creates the effect of the move Midnight Terrain on the battlefield.
cobblemon.ability.refractive.desc: Inflicts 1/8 HP damage to the attacker when attacked with non-contact moves.
cobblemon.ability.sandman.desc:
When a Pokémon with this Ability is hit by a move that makes contact, there is a 30% chance that the attacking Pokémon will become asleep.
If a Pokémon with this Ability is hit by a multi-strike move that makes contact (such as Fury Swipes), each hit has an independent chance to activate this Ability.
Grass-type Pokémon, Pokémon with Overcoat, and Pokémon holding Safety Goggles are now immune to Sandman.
cobblemon.ability.scarecrow.desc: The bearer is immune to any Flying-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.solardiffuse.desc: When a Pokémon with Solar Diffuse enters the battle, it creates the effect of the move Shining Terrain on the battlefield.
cobblemon.ability.acceleration.desc: Acceleration boosts the power of priority moves by 1.5x.
cobblemon.ability.atomizate.desc: Normal-type moves become Nuclear-type moves and receive a 1.3x boost to base power.
cobblemon.ability.bloodlust.desc:
Blood Lust recovers some HP when attacking. It only activates if the attack lands, and activates every time a multi-strike move hits. The amount of HP healed is 1/6 of damage dealt.
The HP regained by Blood Lust is not affected by the Liquid Ooze ability.
cobblemon.ability.chernobyl.desc: Chernobyl creates a Nuclear Fallout for the duration of the Pokémon being in battle.
cobblemon.ability.deepfreeze.desc: When a Pokémon with this Ability is hit by a move that makes contact, there is a 30% chance that the attacking Pokémon will become frozen.
cobblemon.ability.disenchant.desc: The bearer of Disenchant is completely immune to damage from Fairy type moves. It is currently unknown whether Pokémon with Disenchant are also immune to effects from non-damaging Fairy type moves.
cobblemon.ability.elementalist.desc: Elementalist is intended to treat Fire-, Water-, and Electric-type moves as if they were STAB, increasing the damage by 1.5x.
cobblemon.ability.energizate.desc: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves and receive a 1.3x boost to base power.
cobblemon.ability.geigersense.desc: Raises the bearer's Attack and Special Attack by one stage each when a Nuclear-type is in the field.
cobblemon.ability.infuriate.desc: Infuriate raises Attack by one stage when the bearer is hit with a physical move.
cobblemon.ability.lazy.desc:
Lazy causes the bearer to fall asleep as soon as they enter the field. Like Rest, the sleep effect only lasts two turns, albeit there is a chance it ends in the first or second turn.
The sleep from Lazy is normal otherwise. Snore and Sleep Talk can be used in its duration and it will prevent the bearer from being inflicted with other non volatile status conditions. The sleep from Lazy can also be cured with medication or held items and it will not be applied again so long as the bearer remains on the field.
If the bearer is inflicted with other status condition before switching in, Lazy will not activate and the bearer will remain awake.
Copying Lazy with Role Play or Trace, or transferring it with Skill Swap will not cause the target to fall asleep, as the ability only activates when the bearer enters the field. Similarly, negating it with Gastro Acid will not wake the bearer.
Similar to Truant, Lazy is a hindering ability.
cobblemon.ability.leadskin.desc: Gives full immunity to Nuclear type moves, with the exception of Nuclear Waste, which still badly poisons the target.
cobblemon.ability.petrify.desc: Petrify lowers the Speed stat of all opponents by one stage when the bearer enters the field. In a triple battle, Petrify can only lower the speed stat of opponents in range. It can be considered a Speed counterpart to Intimidate.
cobblemon.ability.quickcharge.desc:
Quick Charge increases the priority of the first move used by the bearer by 4, during that turn only.
Quick Guard does not protect the user from Quick Charge-boosted moves since Quick Charge's priority is greater than Quick Guard's.
The boost in priority granted by Quick Charge stacks with other priority changes, making a Quick Charge-boosted Quick Attack +5 priority, and a hypothetical Quick Charge-boosted Roar -2 priority.
cobblemon.ability.rebuild.desc: Heals 1/8 of the Pokemon's HP at the end of each turn if it was not hit by a direct attack. This ability is not interrupted by status effects like Burn or Poison as the heal is applied before status damage.
cobblemon.ability.sharpcoral.desc: Doubles Attack and Special Attack, but halves Defense and Special Defense.
cobblemon.ability.soundboost.desc: Sound-based moves get a 1.3x damage multiplier when used by a Pokémon with this ability. Does not neutralize the Soundproof ability.
cobblemon.ability.stormbringer.desc: Calls forth a Thunderstorm when the bearer is sent out, which lasts for five turns.
cobblemon.ability.momentum.desc: Each turn a move is used consecutively, its power is boosted by 20% up to a maximum increase of 100%. Switching Pokémon or using another move returns the move's power to normal.
cobblemon.ability.arcanum.desc: Fills the area with the power of dragon force.
cobblemon.ability.dustdevil.desc: Creates a storm of earthy dust on the field.
cobblemon.ability.eventidelockemon.desc: Causes a blood moon to rise on the battlefield.
cobblemon.ability.ferroflux.desc: Creates a strong magnetosphere in the area.
cobblemon.ability.galeforce.desc: Creates a strong air current through the area.
cobblemon.ability.incantation.desc: Enchants the area with fairy dust.
cobblemon.ability.seance.desc: Creates a rift between this world and the next.
cobblemon.ability.standoff.desc: Focuses and projects their fighting spirit onto the battlefield.
cobblemon.ability.arenabloom.desc: Causes Spring pollen to coat the battlefield, in addition this Pokémon gradually regains HP in Pollen.
cobblemon.ability.arenacurse.desc: Causes an Autumn curse to coat the battlefield, in addition this Pokémon gradually steals HP from opponents in Cursed Winds.
cobblemon.ability.heathaze.desc: This ability causes the first physical attack directed at Manadza to be reflected, dealing full damage to the attacker. After the attack is deflected, harsh sunlight begins.
cobblemon.ability.icearmor.desc: This ability causes the first special attack directed at Arctikull to be reflected, dealing full damage to the attacker. After the attack is deflected, hail begins.
cobblemon.ability.relicsoul.desc: Filled with the power of the Great Thunderbird, this Pokémon summons a thunderstorm upon entering battle. In addition, it receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.absolutezero.desc: During a Hailstorm, this Pokémon's Ice-type attacks grow in power, doubling their chance to inflict their target with status.
cobblemon.ability.bloomspring.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in Pollen.
cobblemon.ability.carboncapture.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in Smog. In addition, this Pokémon becomes immune to the air's toxic effects.
cobblemon.ability.druidry.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in Fairy Dust. In addition, this Pokémon possesses transmutative properties.
cobblemon.ability.eclipse.desc: This Pokémon's Defense or Special Defense stats are raised sharply in a Blood Moon or Harsh Sunlight.
cobblemon.ability.energizer.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a Thunderstorm.
cobblemon.ability.forked.desc: Heals status conditions in a Thunderstorm.
cobblemon.ability.glacialarmor.desc: Sharply boosts Defense and Special Defense in Hail.
cobblemon.ability.gravitysling.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in magnetosphere.
cobblemon.ability.haunting.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a Cursed Winds or Blood Moon.
cobblemon.ability.malicelockemon.desc: Boosts the Sp.Atk stat in a Blood Moon, but decreases HP every turn.
cobblemon.ability.masterinstinct.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Accuracy in Battle Aura.
cobblemon.ability.nesting.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in Pheromones. If it has a Bug-type ally, the amount healed doubles.
cobblemon.ability.petrichor.desc: While this Pokémon is active, Rain and Blood Moon both gain the effects of the other.
cobblemon.ability.powerabove.desc: Boosts the power of Fairy, Grass-, Fire-, and Water-type moves in Fairy Dust.
cobblemon.ability.powerwithin.desc: Boosts the power of Dragon, Fire-, Electric-, and Ice-type moves in Dragon Force.
cobblemon.ability.smokeandmirrors.desc: Boosts Special damage and increases the chance of confusing a target in a Psychic Field.
cobblemon.ability.souldrain.desc: The Pokémon gradually steals HP from opponents in Cursed Winds.
cobblemon.ability.warpmist.desc: This Pokémon can no longer have its type immunities bypassed. Additionally, this Pokémon gains 1.2x attack power in Fog.
cobblemon.ability.wetanddry.desc: This Pokémon changes formAspects depending on how wet or dry the weather is.
cobblemon.ability.ancientbody.desc: This Pokemon is considered Rock-type, in addition to its other types.
cobblemon.ability.evergreen.desc: Allows Snover and Abomasnow to switch between their Lowland and Highland forms.
cobblemon.ability.expiation.desc: After fainting, the Pokemon that switches into the user's position will be healed.
cobblemon.ability.fieldworker.desc: Multiplies the base power of Grass-type moves by 1.5x.
cobblemon.ability.flytrap.desc: The user's sticky jaws become very effective at trapping Bug-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.foil.desc: The steadfast mind of this Pokémon halves the damage from Psychic-type moves that hit it.
cobblemon.ability.frigidblaze.desc: This Pokémon's Ice-type moves have a chance to burn. As well, its Fire-type moves have a chance to frostbite.
cobblemon.ability.geigeraura.desc: Reduces the HP of adjacent Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.hydrophobic.desc: Immune to the effects of rain and hail, and halves Water-type damage.
cobblemon.ability.nastywebbing.desc: Scatters sticky webs at the feet of the opposing team when this Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
cobblemon.ability.neutralize.desc: When the user drops below half HP, all abilities are nullified and weathers are cleared.
cobblemon.ability.nottobe.desc: Any attacker that faints this Pokémon will also perish.
cobblemon.ability.nullify.desc: Nullifies all weathergies and prevents any from being set up while this Pokémon is on the field.
cobblemon.ability.pearldrop.desc: Drops pearls on the ground when sent out, making it harder to land attacks.
cobblemon.ability.rockybody.desc: Once per battle, the unstable rocks atop this Pokémon will protect from an attack before scattering themselves.
cobblemon.ability.rootcontrol.desc: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Even though it's rooted, it can still switch out.
cobblemon.ability.songbird.desc: While this Pokémon is on the field, its allies will only take damage from attacks.
cobblemon.ability.soulpassage.desc: Upon switching in after the Pokemon in its position fainted, the user gains the highest statistical increase of that Pokemon.
cobblemon.ability.swarming.desc: Forms a powerful swarm while it has a lot of HP. Pheromones causes this swarm to become permanent.
cobblemon.ability.tobe.desc: This Pokémon cannot be knocked out with one hit. Upon reaching 1 HP, it will regain some of its health.
cobblemon.ability.trumpetweevil.desc: The user's sound-based moves become Bug-type and they gain a 1.5x boost.
cobblemon.ability.vegetate.desc: Normal-type moves become Grass-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.avian.desc: STAB to Flying atks, immunity to wind moves.
cobblemon.ability.blazeimpact.desc: May burn the target on contact.
cobblemon.ability.darkenedscales.desc: Halves damage taken from physical moves.
cobblemon.ability.malevolence.desc: Dark-type moves gain priority when its HP is full.
cobblemon.ability.mindtuning.desc: Boosts its best stat in Psychic Terrain.
cobblemon.ability.revivalshedding.desc: Changes formAspects when HP falls below half.
cobblemon.ability.sandshroud.desc: The Pokemon gradually regains HP in a sand- or dust-storm
cobblemon.ability.artificer.desc: Recoil moves increase the user's Speed stat upon use.
cobblemon.ability.apexneigh.desc: Increases Def and SpDef when user defeats an opponent

When user is on the field, all allies including user get 1.5x Special Attack and Special Defense during Hail. User takes no damage from Hail.
cobblemon.ability.haunted.desc:
Powers up Ghost-type moves.
User's Ghost-type moves deal 1.5x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.
cobblemon.ability.cometstorm.desc:
+1 Speed/SpAtk when hit by a Rock-type move
User takes no damage from Rock-type moves, when hit by a Rock-type move their Special Attack and Speed is increased by one stage.
cobblemon.ability.maelstrom.desc:
Traps grounded foes. Contact engulfs them in a whirlpool.
When user is on the field, adjacent grounded enemies cannot escape or switch out. When user is hit by a move that makes contact, there's a 30% chance to trap the attacker in a Whirlpool.
cobblemon.ability.arsonist.desc:
Powers up Fire-type moves.
User's Fire-type moves deal 1.5x damage. Stacks multiplicatively with STAB.
cobblemon.ability.tvface.desc:
Prevent a physical attack. Restored in electric terrain.
Protects from one physical attack, entering electric terrain will restore this shield. Form and stats change when the shield is down.
cobblemon.ability.regrowth.desc:
Regains 1/16 max HP or lowered stats each turn.
All of user's lowered stats are restored by 1 stage at the end of each turn, if user has no lowered stats regain 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn instead.
cobblemon.ability.reaper.desc: Fainting foes in trainer battles heal you for 20%.
cobblemon.ability.destructivecore.desc:
It explodes if its HP becomes half or less.
When HP is reduced to 50% or less, user changes to Reactive Form. This form has reduced defenses but increased Attack and Speed.
cobblemon.ability.symphony.desc: Forms a symphony while it has > 25% HP and at Level 20+.
cobblemon.ability.darkswarm.desc: Forms a dark swarm while it has > 25% HP and at Level 20+.
cobblemon.ability.strongstart.desc: Protects the Pokémon from supereffective attacks on its first turn in battle.
cobblemon.ability.frugal.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it switches its held item with the opponent if the opponent's item is more valuable.
cobblemon.ability.maternal.desc: The Pokémon's Attack stat is boosted if an ally in the party is an Egg.
cobblemon.ability.trashguard.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Poison-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
cobblemon.ability.welltrained.desc: The Pokémon takes neutral damage from Fighting-type attacks.
cobblemon.ability.melty.desc: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered but its Speed stat is boosted.
cobblemon.ability.panicshield.desc: Evades supereffective moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
cobblemon.ability.headless.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat if it is confused.
cobblemon.ability.doubledragon.desc: Boosts the power of Dragon-type moves but makes them consume more PP.
cobblemon.ability.radicalmutagen.desc: Changes all adjacent Pokémon's types to a randomly selected type.
cobblemon.ability.foretell.desc: The Pokémon foretells the outcome of the fight, boosting one of its stats to aid in battle.
cobblemon.ability.slipnslide.desc: The Pokémon's Water-type moves are followed by a bonus Fighting-type attack and vice-versa.
cobblemon.ability.versatilebody.desc: The Pokémon gains a third type if it has a status condition.
cobblemon.ability.coldblanket.desc: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions during snowfall.
cobblemon.ability.conflagrate.desc: Normal-type moves become Fire-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.splashfrolic.desc: The Pokémon recovers HP whenever Mud Sport or Water Sport are used in battle.
cobblemon.ability.calmingaura.desc: Contact with this Pokémon may cause sleep.
cobblemon.ability.gourmand.desc: The Pokémon's HP is restored when it eats any Local Specialty.
cobblemon.ability.munchmissile.desc: When the Pokémon uses Dig or Bulldoze, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
cobblemon.ability.countingsheep.desc: Pokémon stay asleep for longer when this Pokémon is active.
cobblemon.ability.nightguard.desc: Reduces damage dealt to sleeping allies.
cobblemon.ability.soprano.desc: The Pokémon's sound-based moves hit all adjacent Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.partyanimal.desc: Doubles the effects of stat changes this Pokémon gains from performing dance moves.
cobblemon.ability.snowfort.desc: The Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are boosted when hit with an Ice-type move.
cobblemon.ability.matingcall.desc: The Pokémon's Attack stat is boosted for every other Pokémon of the opposite gender in battle.
cobblemon.ability.hibernate.desc: The Pokémon enters its Cryosleep forme when frozen or put to sleep.
cobblemon.ability.dyingmemory.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its type changes to the type of the ally in the party that was most recently defeated.
cobblemon.ability.takeover.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it steals the target's Ability.
cobblemon.ability.talkback.desc: Whenever a sound move is used in battle by an opposing Pokémon, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that sound move itself.
cobblemon.ability.terraform.desc: Powers up Ground-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
cobblemon.ability.coldblooded.desc: Restores the Pokémon's HP in harsh sunlight or when it is hit by Fire-type moves. Reduces HP in snow, and increases the damage received from Ice-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.backupthread.desc: Protects the Pokémon from low priority moves.
cobblemon.ability.frenzy.desc: If the Pokémon misses the opponent because of accuracy, its Attack stat will be boosted sharply in a frenzy.
cobblemon.ability.glitched.desc: When hit by a move, the Pokémon's type will change randomly and one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
cobblemon.ability.darkmight.desc: Boosts the power of Ghost- and Dark-type moves in a dark overcast.
cobblemon.ability.hexpeller.desc: If hit by a Ghost-type move, the Pokémon retaliates, dealing damage instead of taking it.
cobblemon.ability.buriedhead.desc: Head protection prevents flinching, being confused, recoil damage or being affected by Intimidate. When hit by an attack, the Pokémon loses its head protection and becomes aggressive.
cobblemon.ability.streamline.desc: The Pokémon's streamlined body halves the damage taken by Water- and Flying-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.drench.desc: Changes the attacker's type to Water when the Pokémon is knocked out.
cobblemon.ability.boxfort.desc: The Pokémon's Defense stat is boosted while asleep.
cobblemon.ability.redhot.desc: The Pokémon's Steel-type moves have a chance to burn.
cobblemon.ability.highrise.desc: The Pokémon's Ground-type moves can hit Flying-types.
cobblemon.ability.foulmouth.desc: The Pokémon's sound-based moves have a chance to taunt the opponent.
cobblemon.ability.sugarcrash.desc: The Pokémon's Fairy-type moves are boosted, but lower the Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
cobblemon.ability.coven.desc: The Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted for every other Dark-type Pokémon in battle.
cobblemon.ability.diversion.desc: Opponents sometimes target this Pokémon instead of their original target.
cobblemon.ability.metallize.desc: Normal-type moves become Steel-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.sunshroud.desc: The Pokémon summons a dark overcast when it enters a battle.
cobblemon.ability.sinistersurge.desc: Turns the ground into Sinister Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
cobblemon.ability.falseflier.desc: The Pokémon takes direct damage as if it was Flying-type.
cobblemon.ability.falsefire.desc: The Pokémon takes direct damage as if it was Fire-type.
